public class BlockEntityBloodChest extends BlockEntityTickingTankInventory<BlockEntityBloodChest> implements net.minecraft.world.MenuProvider, net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.LidBlockEntity
A chest that is able to repair tools with the use of blood. Partially based on cpw's IronChests.
